body:
`docs/07-crosscutting.md` states that `split.read_lineage` returns `None` when the lineage record carries a nonnumeric `depth`. It does not: the reader is permissive and `_recorded_depth` absorbs the value (template/src/pdca_harness/split.py, lineage reader — around line 373 as of pdca-pdca issue_456).

This is not cosmetic — the documented-but-untrue behavior was the source of the reviewer's C3/T2 FAIL findings on pdca-pdca issue_456: the reviewer held the implementation against the doc's claim.

Fix: delete (or correct) the clause so the doc matches the permissive reader.

Surfaced as a §10 Act candidate on pdca-pdca issue_456; routed upstream at the 2026-08-09 Act review (process/act-log.md).
title: docs/07-crosscutting.md: false claim that split.read_lineage returns None for a nonnumeric depth — cost a reviewer C3/T2 FAIL
